name: jacobi_untuned
description: Jacobi 2-D relaxation (GiOMP port): 16384 x 16384 mesh, 1000 iterations, rows split over the ranks; each iteration's sweep is followed by two puts of one 128 KB row to the top and bottom neighbours, then a fence. One GH200 per rank, 2 nodes. The program first runs the same solve on one GPU and checks every cell of the distributed result against it. Starting point: an untuned build, every put left to the host after its kernel (no site pipelined) and every kernel at clang's own distribute chunk.

OMP_NUM_TEAMS.note: teams per kernel for every launch; 0 lets the runtime pick

OMP_TEAMS_THREAD_LIMIT.note: threads per team, at least a warp; unset lets the runtime pick

OMPX_PIPE_COUNT_MIN_LOG2.note: puts smaller than 2^n bytes to a cross-node peer wait for the next quiet instead of being sent by the kernel
